balls.text: Zaheer moves outside his off stump and nudges the last ball towards midwicket for  a single
Zaheer gets squared up and tries to pull the short ball, he misses, just the one ball left now
banged in short by Waston who follows the batsman as he tries to back away and play the ball on the off side, Rawat appeals for a catch behind but the ball had missed the edge
pushed off the back foot towards cover point for one
that's a very high full toss, no ball called, played towards square leg for one

run out! Watson bangs in the bouncer in, Praveen tries to upper cut it but misses, Zaheer tries to run the bye, Rawat tries to run out Zaheer at the batsman's end but misses, the ball goes to Watson who collects and underarms the ball towards the bowler's end and the direct hit finds Praveen well short, I wonder if Praveen is injured for he was running very slowly
Zaheer clears his front foot out of the way and pulls a short of a length delivery to Smith at deep square leg
banged in short, Praveen thinks about hooking but doesn't
Praveen backs away and tries to hit the ball on the leg side, Trivedi follows him and beats him with the slower ball
the slower ball on off and middle stump, defended off the back foot towards the bowler
Trivedi bowls a low full toss, he was looking for the yorker, Zaheer swings across the line and hits it to deep square leg
that is smashed! Zaheer moves forward to a fuller ball and plays a blazing cover drive to the boundary
Zaheer backs away to a short ball and cuts, he just manges to clear Tanvir at backward point and the ball runs to the third man boundary
thrown up again, down the track and under-edged to midwicket for a single
teasing legbreak this time, pitched outside leg and turning away, attempted slog doesn't work, deflects from the pads onto the off side
that was a quick one on the pads, flicked away in the air but it's in the gap, a quick couple from the batsmen
short this time, pulled away hard down the ground for four, that raced away through long-on, tennis forehand that
quicker one outside off, pushed back down the ground
tossed up outside off, crashed back down the ground, Warne tries to stop it but gets a sting on his left hand, deflects away towards long-off for a single, Warne is in some pain there
another full toss, this time lower, driven straight to long-on, should have put that away for more
high full toss, he's surprised by that and could have been above waist height, pushed to mid-on, no signal from the umpires, the bowler apologises to the batsman, though
slower one again, 106kph, Zaheer tries to slog through midwicket but can't make contact
on his pads, turned away through midwicket, there's a mis-field there but they settle for two
short and targetted at the neck, can't get it away, drops close to his feet and the bowler is ready to field that

slower one, tantalising ball, he tries to back away and slog over midwicket but ends up looking silly, checks his shot and was flummoxed, almost carries back to the bowler for the caught and bowled but eludes his lunge,
tossed up on off and middle stump, defended on the off side on the front foot
driven off the front foot towards long on for one
bowled fast and wide outside off, left alone by Praveen
this time it is not a mis-hit, Praveen clears his front foot out of the way and smashes the ball high over the midwicket boundary, massive hit
Praveen tries to slog a flighted delivery and gets a thick top edge, the ball flies high in the air, it's a mis-hit but the ball manages to clear the straight boundary
tossed up on off stump, Praveen tries to slog down the ground but gets an inside edge past the wicketkeeper
the slower ball outside off stump, Zaheer stays in his crease and tries to defend but gets beaten
short of a length delivery, Zaheer defends off the back foot and wants the single but Trivedi runs quickly towards the ball to save runs
bowled full on off and middle stump, Praveen comes forward and pushes the ball towards long-on for a single
the slower ball just outside off stump at 102 kmh, Praveen tries to smash it straight but gets beaten
banged in short by Trivedi, Praveen ducks under it
Praveen moves right across his stumps and plays a fine paddle shot to the fine leg boundary, shades of Dougie Marillier there, risky but it's paid off

run out! bowled flat on middle stump, Joshi flicks off his pads to square leg and wants the single, Praveen sends him back, Tanvir throws the ball superbly towards Rawat who breaks the stumps with Joshi inches short, he didn't run back with any urgency whatsoever, the screen initially flashes not out but then changes it to the right decision
defended once again to the fielder at square leg
Joshi moves across his stumps and tries to play the slog sweep, he hits it to the man at square leg
a flighted full toss on middle stump, Praveen drives towards long-on for a single
that was flat and straight on middle stump, Praveen waited for it and defended off the back foot
Joshi leans forward and tries to drive Warne through cover. the ball spins into him and he gets an inside edge past the bowler
Joshi strides forward and plays the square drive through point for one
played off the pads behind square leg for one
that is a colossal hit, Praveen got under the ball and smashed it with sher power high over the long-on boundary, that just missed the roof!
bowled slowly through the air on off stump, flicked in the air towards midwicket for one
pushed off the back foot through midwicket for a single
he gets it to turn and bounce quite sharply into the right-hander, Praveen was beaten
Joshi leans forward and tries to drive through the off side but ends up playing it back towards Warne
bowled flat through the air on off stump, Joshi defends back towards the bowler

caught! Warne bowls the googly and Boucher tries to drive it through the off side, he gets beaten by the turn into him and gets a thick inside edge that hits Rawat on the pads and lobs up on the leg side, Rawat is alert to the situation and scampers across to catch the rebound
Boucher once again tries to sweep but misses and gets hit by the straighter one right in front of the stumps, Warne appeals again but it was perhaps a bit too high
tossed up on leg and middle, that was much slower, Boucher tried to sweep but missed, Warne appealed for lbw
bowled flat and straight on off stump, driven off the front foot towards cover
good length delivery on middle and off stump, defended on the back foot towards the bowler
fuller length outside off stump, it was a slower ball and Praveen once again played an ugly slog, he didn't make contact
banged in short, Praveen backs away and has a slog across the line but misses
short of a length delivery rises into Praveen's hips, he gets cramped for room and defends on the off side
Boucher jumps on to the back foot and flicks a short of a length ball off his hips towards long leg
pitches on a good length around off stump and angles across the right-hander, Boucher gets squared up and the ball goes past his outside edge
excellent bouncer from Munaf to end an excellent over, Praveen ducks under it
good length ball on off stump, defended back to the bowler

caught! Virat backs away to a  good length ball over off and middle stump and tries to cut through the off side, rather a rash shot that, he gets beaten by the extra bounce and feathers a nick through to Rawat
Munaf gets the ball to bounce sharply from a good length on Virat who tries to cut but gets beaten
Virat tries to run the ball towards third man but gets beaten by a short of a length ball outside off stump
Boucher moves forward and gets squared up by a good length ball, he opens the face to play the ball through point
played towards point off the front foot
short of a length delivery outside off stump, Virat gets beaten

what a stunning catch! But has he hit the rope? Virat got under the ball and smashed it high in the air towards deep midwicket, Jadeja got under it and jumped up in the air towards his left and caught the ball as it was going over the boundary, he managed to dive back inside the boundary but as he hit the ground his hand hit the rope, terrific terrific effort but it's six
short of a length wide outside off stump, Boucher tries to pull but hits it with the bottom of the bat through midwicket
short ball and Virat pulls, he too hits it flat but the ball falls short of the fielder on the deep square leg boundary
Virat backs away towards the leg side to make room but Trivedi follows him, he cuts it towards point
tight line and length on off stump, Boucher gets behind the line of the ball on the front foot and defends back towards the bowler
Virat tries to cut but there's no room for the shot, he bottom edges it towards the wicketkeeper
short of a length on off stump with a bit of seam movement into the right-hander, the batsman gets an inside edge while trying to defend and runs a single towards square leg
played off the pads behind square for  a single

caught on the pull! Taylor moves towards the off side and tries to pull a short ball, he's hit it firmly but again there's no elevation and Smith takes a flat catch on the deep square leg boundary, Rajasthan are right back in this
good length delivery on off stump, Virat drops it with soft hands on the off side and runs a quick single towards point
played towards point for a quick single to end the over
Trivedi tries the slower ball but strays down leg side, Benson signals another wide
another short ball, Virat ducks under it and the umpire calls it wide, it was too high
banged in short outside off stump, Virat ducks under it
he gets off the mark by pushing the ball towards point, there's an overthrow at the bowler's end and he gets a second

caught! The length wasn't short enough to play a pull but Kallis managed to make good contact, however he didn't get any elevation and placed it straight down Munaf's throat at long leg, that was a flat catch and it was well taken, Rajasthan have made a vital breakthrough
slower ball at 105 kmh on middle stump, Taylor flicks it through midwicket for just the single
short ball outside off stump, Kallis moves towards the off side and pulls to deep backward square leg, over to Taylor now, the Chinnaswamy is alive and roaring
Taylor stays in his crease and pushes at a good length ball outside off, he gets a thick edge through the vacant slip cordon, third man is in the circle and that's four more
this time he doesn't bother with the flatness, he gets under the ball and pulls it high and far over the midwicket boundary, stunning hit and Warne looks concerned
phew! Taylor plants his foot forward, sees the length is short on off stump and pulls the ball flat over midwicket, that was hot so flat yet it was a one bounce four
Kallis moves towards the off side this time and nudges a good length ball from off stump towards midwicket for one
short of a length outside off stump, Kallis backs away to make room and comes forward to try and blast it over the off side, he gets beaten
good length delivery on off stump, Kallis moves forward and pushes the ball towards point with an open face of the bat
will it carry? No it falls just short. Taylor backed away to make room but didn't connect properly, he hit it uppishly but the ball fell just short of cover

what improvisation, the length was good outside off stump, Taylor moves across his stumps, keeps his head perfectly still and swats it from outside off through midwicket for four, perfect balance as he dispatched the slower one
short of a length delivery pitches outside off and angles into Taylor, cramping him for room, he waits in his crease and pushes it towards mid-off
good length delivery on off stump, Kallis defends on the off side and Taylor sprints through for the single
this time he moves across his stumps to get inside the line and flicks the ball off his pads towards the long leg boundary, he backed away to the first ball and now moved across his stumps
Kallis backs away towards the leg side to make room and lofts a good length ball from Watson inside out over cover for four more, terrific bat speed
that is clobbered! The length was too full outside off stump, Taylor ploughed forward and drove the ball ferociously through point, sheer power
full ball in the blockhole outside off stump, Taylor tries to work it on the off side but gets beaten
Tanvir slants the bouncer at Taylor's head from round the wicket, Taylor stays in his crease, drops his wrists and sways out of the way
the slower ball ends up as a loose full toss, Taylor leans forward and pushes it into the gap between midwicket and mid-on, two fielders chase it but the ball wins
a low full toss and Taylor can't get it away, it was nearly a yorker an Taylor was cramped for room
fullish length outside off stump, Taylor leans forward and lofts the ball over cover for a one-bounce four
a fraction short outside off stump, Kallis stands on the back foot and drives powerfully to point where Kaif intercepts the ball, another terrific over from Watto
that is a quick bouncer, Kallis gets under it and Rawat barely managed to hold it in the webbing of his gloves
another slower ball on off and middle, Taylor nudges it towards midwicket and sets off for the single,  a mis-field allows them to complete it easily
good length delivery outside off stump, Taylor moves forward and lets the ball go through to Rawat

caught! This time Chanders tries to pull the ball against the angle across him, it was a trifle short and this time the top edge flies high and straight to Jadeja once again at third man, he tales another well-judged catch
the slower ball outside off stump, Chanders gets beaten on the drive
would you believe it! Taylor tried to smash a good length ball against the angle across him to the leg side, the ball hits the top edge and flies over the third man boundary, freakish boundary
going going going gone! Taylor steps forward and gets under a fullish ball from Tanvir and smashes it straight over his head for a sizable six
that's wide, it pitched outside leg and carried on past the leg stump, Taylor did try to play the leg glance but he couldn't  connect
a full ball swings into Chanders who chops down at it and squeezes the ball through point
pitches on a good length outside off stump and straightens off the pitch, Chanderpaul leans forward but lets it go in the end

full and straight on off stump, Taylor moves across and tries to flick against the angle across him, he misses and gets hit on the pad, Tanvir appeals but the angle may have been taking it past off stump
good length first up on middle and off, Taylor moves forward and blocks towards the leg side
fantastic over, the last ball is on a good length on middle stump, Chanders tries to move across and work it on the leg side but doesn't make proper contact
fuller and wider outside off stump, Chanderpaul tries to cut but misses once more, this is turning into an excellent first over
132 kmh, once again Watto pitches around off stump and seams the ball across the left-hander, Chanders fends at it off the front foot and gets beaten yet again
beaten! Watson pitches on a good length and seams the ball away from Chanderpaul who gets squared up as he tries to defend

caught! Dravid falls first ball! Watson bangs it in short, it didn't rise much and Dravid went for the pull, he didn't control it well and hit it high in the air towards long leg, Jadeja was position on the boundary line and took a well judged catch
full ball on middle and off stump, bit of swing for Watson, Chanderpaul drives towards mid-off and sets off for the single, had Trivedi hit from mid-off Chanders would have been out!
Watson finishes the match in style, he gets down on one knee and slog sweeps Joshi over midwicket for four, Rajasthan win by a comprehensive seven wicket margin with three overs to spare
defended off the back foot with a straight bat towards the bowler
short and wide outside off stump, Kaif stands on the back foot and cuts between point and backward point for four, just two more needed to win now for Rajasthan
excellent line, Zaheer pitches on a good length outside off and slants it across Kaif who tries to defend on the front foot and gets beaten
good length on leg and middle, Kaif leans forward and defends towards midwicket
short of a length on off stump, Kaif waits on the back foot and defends on the off side
good length delivery from Zaheer angles across the right-hander from over the wicket, Kaif lets it go

Smith falls one short of his fifty, he came down the track and chipped Joshi straight to Kumble at long-on, he didn't try to hit it with power and got his placement wrong, he was looking to hit it wider of long on I think
defended on the front foot towards midwicket
Smith tried to slog the ball over the leg side but got an outside edge down to the third man boundary, he's on 49
Smith comes forward and lofts Joshi through the line back over his head for four, just ten needed now
Watson tries to cut from very close to off stump, Virat dives to his left to save runs at cover
bowled flat through the air on middle stump, defended on the front foot
a bit of room offered outside off stump, Watson cuts but can't beat Kallis at backward point
bowled flat and straight on middle stump, Watson gets behind the line and defends with a straight bat
bowled flat down the leg side, Smith flicks the ball off his pads towards fine leg
Smith comes forward and defends on the leg side
bowled full on middle stump, Watson leans forward and drives the ball towards long on for one
Smith waits for a flat ball and nudges it off his pads behind square

make that 26, Watson has just waited for a full ball on middle stump and flicked it neatly off his pads, he's timing is immaculate, I finally see a fielder but he has no chance at deep backward square leg
and again! Watson leans forward and lofts the ball into the gap at the midwicket boundary, where are all the fielders? 22 runs of the over so far
Watson goes again! This time he gets under the ball and slices it high on the off side over cover, the ball falls inches inside the boudnary
too full this time from Praveen and too straight, Watson moves forward and flicks crisply into the gap at deep square leg
that's short again and Watson uses all his muscle to pull the ball high and far over midwicket, he pulled that from outside off for a six to bring up the 100
he starts with a short ball down leg side which Watson tries to pull, he gets enough bat on it to place the ball past Boucher to the fine leg boundary
Smith moves on to the back foot and plays the ball off his pads towards square leg
bowled full and flat through the air, Watson leans forward and nudges towards midwicket for  a single
played off the back foot behind point
this time Watson moves forward and lofts the ball cleanly over the midwicket boundary for the first six of the innings
Watson tries to sweep after moving a long way outside off stump and misses, that ball missed off stump in fact
too short from Joshi and Smith has enough time to get down on one knee and pull from outside off towards deep square leg
worked off the pads behind square leg for another single
driven off the front foot towards mid-off
Watson moves forward once again and drives towards mid-on
driven off the front foot towards mid-on
Smith this time moves forward and plays the leg glance to a delivery that pitched outside leg and went on to his pads
bowled flat through the air on middle and leg, Watson moves back and works the ball off his pads behind square
Smith waits for the ball outside off and plays a late cut to the third man boundary, that brings up the 50 partnership as well
Smith leans forward and defends back to the bowler, Rajasthan are in no hurry here
bowled full and straight by Joshi, Watson defends on the front foot
defended on the front foot towards the off side
bowled flat through the air and straight, Watson moves forward and blocks with a straight bat
bowled flat on leg stump, Smith moves forward and plays the ball off his pads behind square
bowled fuller and straighter on middle stump, driven back to the bowler on the front foot
that's not that short and Watson mis-times his pull shot to deep backward square leg
bowled flat through the air on off stump, Watson stays in his crease and plays the ball behind square on the off side
fired down leg side, that's a wide from Kumble, Boucher did well to move quickly to his left and collect
driven down the ground towards long-off for a single
bowled slowly through the air on middle stump, Smith leans forward and closes the face of the bat to play the ball towards square leg
fuller length on middle stump from Kumble, Watson moves forward and nudges the ball towards the leg side for a sharp single
Smith moves forward and mis-times a drive off a good length ball on the off side
Kallis should know better than to bowl that length to his captain, it's too short and Smith pulls the ball in front of midwicket for a boundary
Smith tries to cut a short of a length delivery that is too close to him and chops it into the ground towards a wide slip
good length delivery outside off stump, Watson leans forward and opens the face of the bat to play the ball towards third man
width offered outside off stump and Smith makes use of it by cutting towards third man off the back foot
short of a length on middle stump, Watson waits in his crease and works the ball off his pads behind square
that's the straighter one from Kumble, Smith tried to defend on the back foot and got beaten
bowled full on middle and leg, Watson turns the ball off his pads behind square
full flat and straight on off stump, Watson moves forward to defend but gets an inside edge on to the pad
fuller and quicker on off stump, Watson brings his bat down in time and defends
another short ball and Watson gets down on one knee and pulls behidn square leg for four more, poor length from Kumble, far too short
he drags the ball short and Watson rocks on to the back foot and pulls powerfully to the midwicket boundary, not the best start from Kumble
good length from Vinay Kumar outside off, Smith defends on the front foot
that's not that short at all and Smith pulls the ball from outside off stump past the fielder at mid-on for four, that was pure muscle from Smith
Watson tries to work the ball on the leg side by closing the face but gets a leading edge towards the off side
that's a bit short and Smith pulls off the back foot towards Praveen at deep square leg for a single
good length delivery angling across the left-hander, Smith tries to cut but gets a bottom edge into the ground towards slips
good length delivery angling into off and middle stump, flicked off the pads towards square leg for a single
that's a high full toss which Smith waits for and dispatches to the midwicket boundary with a flick of his hips
good length from Zaheer outside off stump, Watson moves forward and plays the ball behind point for  a single
banged in short by Zaheer from round the wicket, Watson shapes up to pull but gets beaten for pace and doesn't make proper contact
full ball on middle and leg, Smith moves across and plays the ball behind square
Smith moves forward and defends a good length ball back towards the bowler

loud appeal for lbw from Zaheer, that was pitched on a good length and was angling into the left-hander, Smith played it from his crease and was hit on the pad, that was a close shout, there may have been an inside edge
good length delivery on off stump, defended on the front foot towards the off side
too short once again outside off, this time Smith moves towards the ball and cuts towards third man
that's too short and Smith latches on to it and pulls it hard through midwicket for four
Smith tries to pull a short of a length delivery but doesn't make contact
good length delivery on off stump, Watson waits on the back foot and pushes the ball towards midwicket for a single
full ball slanting down leg side, Watson tries to glance it but can't connect
Smith moves back to a short of a length ball and opens the face to guide the ball behind point
dangerous leave by Watson, Zaheer went round the wicket and slanted the ball into the right-hander from a good length, Watson moved forward and let it go very close to his off stump
good length delivery angling into the left-hander, Smith uses the angle into him and closes the face of the bat to play the ball behind square leg
that's too straight and Smith is very strong off his pads, he moves across towards the off and flicks towards the vacant fine leg boundary
full and straight from Zaheer from over the wicket, Smith gets behind the line of the ball and defends towards the bowler

that's gone high in the air and Boucher takes an excellent catch! Zaheer banged it in short, Yusuf lined up to play the pull, he tried to hit it from outside off and got a top edge that flew miles in the air towards a very fine fine leg region, Boucher ran after it and settled perfectly under a swirling catch
Smith stays in his crease and works the ball off his pads behind square for a single
that's a loose full toss, Yusuf drives if back over the bowler's head, he takes his bottom hand off the bat as he connects but still hits it for a one-bounce four to long off
banged in short by Praveen, Yusuf tries to hook but the ball goes over his bat
Smith moves forward and across and defends towards extra cover, he runs a very risky single but Taylor fails to pick up the ball
the slower ball outside off stump, Pathan pushes the ball towards point with soft hands and calls for the single, had the throw hit the stumps at the batsman's end Smith would have been out
Yusuf moves back in his crease and flicks a good length ball off his pads to square leg
good length delivery on leg and middle, Smith moves forward and pushes the ball towards midwicket for a single
fuller length on middle and leg stump, Yusuf tries to flick but misses and gets hit on the pad

that wasn't a bad ball at all, Yusuf used the angle into him from round the wicket and lofted the ball high in the air with a short arm jab, the ball fell just inside the deep midwicket boundary before going over
short of a length ball on off stump from round the wicket, defended on the back foot towards the bowler
Yusuf tried to smash it again but mis-hit it towards the bowler
a bit too full outside off stump, Yusuf moves forward and drives through the line, he plays the ball in the air past mid-off, he hit it flat for a one-bounce four
good length delivery on off and middle stump, Smith pushes forward and tries to defend, the inside edge goes towards square leg
fuller length on the pads, Yusuf moves across his crease and flicks the ball off his pads towards long leg where Joshi fumbles to allow the boundary
short and wide outside off stump, Yusuf stays in his crease and cuts the ball through point for four, he's started right where he left off the other night against Deccan Chargers

caught! Rawat charged down the track and tried to swing Praveen over the leg side, the ball was on a good length and moved away from the right-hander, the ball grazed the outside edge and went through to Boucher who took an easy catch, Praveen is thrilled and pumped up!
a full ball swings into Rawat who moves across his stumps and plays the ball towards midwicket
good length once again outside off, Smith moves forward and opens the face to play the ball through point to get off the mark
good length delivery outside off stump, Smith waits in his crease and pushes the ball towards point
